description: This file is a shell script used for testing remerge-diff handling in a git-related project. It sets up various git merge scenarios, including conflicts, resolution, and filtering, and validates the output of remerge-diff commands against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success

methods.description: Asserts that the given command sequence fails as expected.
